probe.sh:
export LC_ALL=C
section() { printf '\n=== %s ===\n' "$*"; }
observe() { printf '+ %s\n' "$*"; "$@" 2>&1; printf 'status=%s\n' "$?"; }
section identity
observe id -u
observe uname -a
observe uname -m
for f in /etc/os-release /etc/tizen-release /proc/cpuinfo /sys/devices/system/cpu/online /sys/devices/system/cpu/present /sys/devices/system/cpu/possible; do observe cat "$f"; done
observe getconf LONG_BIT
observe ls -l /bin/sh
observe od -An -tx1 -N5 /bin/sh
grep '^MemTotal:' /proc/meminfo
for f in /proc/device-tree/model /proc/device-tree/compatible; do
 printf '+ %s\n' "$f"
 tr '\000' '\n' < "$f"
done
section iomem
awk 'tolower($0) ~ /kernel code|kernel data|debug|coresight|trace|etm|ptm|funnel|replicator|etb|etf|etr|tmc|tpiu|\<cti\>/' /proc/iomem
printf 'iomem_status=%s\n' "$?"
section sources
observe ls -la /sys/bus/coresight/devices/
observe ls -la /sys/bus/event_source/devices/
section dmesg
dmesg 2>&1 | awk 'tolower($0) ~ /coresight|(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(etm|ptm|cti|tmc|tpiu)([^[:alnum:]_]|$)|hw perfevents|permission denied|operation not permitted|failed to read/'
section configs
pat='^(# )?CONFIG_(CORESIGHT[^ =]*|PERF_EVENTS|HW_PERF_EVENTS|ARM_PMU[^ =]*|KALLSYMS[^ =]*|DEBUG_INFO[^ =]*|ARM_LPAE|STRICT_KERNEL_RWX|THUMB2_KERNEL|ARM64_PSEUDO_NMI)([ =]|$)'
observe ls -l /proc/config.gz
if test -r /proc/config.gz; then printf '+ zcat /proc/config.gz | grep CONFIG\n'; zcat /proc/config.gz | grep -E "$pat"; fi
for f in /boot/config-*; do if test -e "$f"; then observe ls -l "$f"; grep -E "$pat" "$f"; else echo '/boot/config-* no visible match'; fi; done
section pmu-sysfs
for d in /sys/bus/event_source/devices/*; do
 printf 'PMU %s\n' "$d"
 for f in "$d/type" "$d/cpus" "$d/cpumask" "$d"/events/* "$d"/format/*; do if test -f "$f"; then printf '%s = ' "$f"; cat "$f"; fi; done
done
section perf-permissions
observe cat /proc/sys/kernel/perf_event_paranoid /proc/sys/kernel/kptr_restrict
awk '{n++; if ($1 ~ /^0+$/) zero++; else nonzero++} END {printf "kallsyms rows=%d zero=%d nonzero=%d\n", n,zero,nonzero}' /proc/kallsyms
printf 'kallsyms_status=%s\n' "$?"
printf 'PATH=%s\n' "$PATH"
observe which perf
observe command -v perf
if command -v perf >/dev/null 2>&1; then observe perf --version; observe perf version --build-options; fi
section display-and-sessions
ps -eo comm | grep -Ei 'enlightenment|weston|sway|kwin|mutter|labwc|wayfire|xorg|xwayland|surfaceflinger|compositor'
for f in /sys/class/drm/*/status /sys/class/hdmi/*/status /sys/class/display/*/status; do if test -e "$f"; then observe cat "$f"; else printf 'no match: %s\n' "$f"; fi; done
observe ls -l /sys/class/drm
observe who
section load
ps -eo pid,user,pcpu,pmem,comm --sort=-pcpu | head -n 11
section temps-cpufreq
for f in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/type /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/temp /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy*/scaling_governor /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy*/scaling_min_freq /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy*/scaling_max_freq /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy*/cpuinfo_min_freq /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy*/cpuinfo_max_freq /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy*/scaling_cur_freq /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy*/affected_cpus; do
 if test -e "$f"; then printf '%s = ' "$f"; cat "$f"; else echo "no match: $f"; fi
done
section cleanup
printf 'uid='; id -u
printf 'Board probe used stdout only and created no temporary directory.\n'
printf '__BOARD13_DONE__\n'

device-tree.command:
export LC_ALL=C
find -L /proc/device-tree -type f -name compatible -exec sh -c '
for f do
 d=${f%/compatible}
 c=$(tr "\000" "\n" < "$f")
 printf "NODE %s\n%s\n" "$d" "$c"
 if printf "%s\n%s\n" "${d##*/}" "$c" | grep -qiE "coresight|(^|[^a-z])(etm|ptm|funnel|replicator|etb|etf|etr|tmc|tpiu|stm|cti|pmu)([^a-z]|$)|gic"; then
  for name in reg interrupts interrupts-extended interrupt-parent "#interrupt-cells" phandle linux,phandle interrupt-names interrupt-affinity status; do
   if test -r "$d/$name"; then printf "PROPERTY %s\n" "$name"; od -An -v -tx1 "$d/$name"; fi
  done
 fi
done' sh {} +
printf 'find_status=%s\n' "$?"
for name in interrupt-parent '#address-cells' '#size-cells'; do
 f=/proc/device-tree/$name
 if test -r "$f"; then printf 'ROOT PROPERTY %s\n' "$name"; od -An -v -tx1 "$f"; fi
done

printf '%s\n' '__BOARD13_device-tree_DONE__'

dt-names.command:
find -L /proc/device-tree -type d -print | awk '
{n++; node=tolower($0); sub(/^.*\//,"",node); if (node ~ /coresight|(^|[^a-z])(etm|ptm|funnel|replicator|etb|etf|etr|tmc|tpiu|stm|cti)[0-9]*([^a-z]|$)/) print}
END {print "directories_scanned=" n}'
printf 'pipeline=%s\n' "${PIPESTATUS[*]}"
printf '__BOARD13_DT_NAMES_DONE__\n'
